title: French Quarter New Orleans - 900 block of Royal Street, 1926
blurb: Original caption: "N.W. on Royal street from corner of Dumaine St. - New Orleans, La." Notes: 1926 view looking downriver from about 905 Royal, showing most of the 900 block, with cast iron balconies, automobile and pedestrian traffic, shop signs. A man sits on front stoop reading a newspaper; just past him the cornstalk fence of the Cornstalk Hotel is seen.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.11% vertical error and 0.01° of rotation. Depth measured deep (2.51% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
